topic.coverageNote: Open review of psoriasis that appears during biologic therapy. It defines the reaction, names TNF inhibitors and later cytokine inhibitors, describes the usual sites, and ties stopping or switching the drug to the underlying disease and the severity of the rash.

mcqs.question: What did this review say the new psoriasiform lesions during anti-TNF treatment of idiopathic psoriasis were named?
mcqs.explanation: The review says that during anti-TNF treatment of classical idiopathic psoriasis a small portion of patients develop new psoriasiform lesions, and this phenomenon was named paradoxical psoriasis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: This contradictory phenomenon was named paradoxical psoriasis which resembles idiopathic psoriasis clinically but presents overlapped histological patterns and distinct immunological processes.

mcqs.question: Besides TNF inhibitors, which biologic classes does the review say have been reported to induce paradoxical psoriasis?

options.A: IL-12/23, IL-17A, IL-4/13, IL-6, and IL-23 inhibitors
options.D: No drug other than a TNF inhibitor is named

mcqs.explanation: The review lists ustekinumab, secukinumab, ixekizumab, brodalumab, dupilumab, tocilizumab, siltuximab, risankizumab, and guselkumab among biologics reported to have induced paradoxical psoriasis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: biologics (IL-12/23 inhibitor: Ustekinumab; IL-17A inhibitor: Secukinumab, Ixekizumab, Brodalumab; IL-4/13 inhibitor: Dupilumab; IL-6 inhibitor: Tocilizumab, Siltuximab; IL-23 inhibitor: Risankizumab, Guselkumab)

mcqs.question: Which sites does the review say are usual in paradoxical psoriasis?

options.A: Palms and soles, or the scalp
options.D: Only extensor plaques identical to untreated plaque psoriasis, with palms spared

mcqs.explanation: The review says palmoplantar or scalp involvement is usual, and that severe scalp involvement can develop into alopecia. Nail involvement is less often.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Palmoplantar or scalp involvement is usual as well and scalp involvement can develop into alopecia in severe cases.

mcqs.question: What do the review's highlights say about stopping the biologic?

options.A: Discontinuation is not necessary, and withdrawal of the culprit drug is recommended when the underlying disease is uncontrolled
options.B: Every biologic must be stopped on the day the first scale appears
options.C: The culprit drug is never withdrawn
options.D: The highlights do not discuss drug continuation

mcqs.explanation: The highlights say discontinuation of biologics is not necessary, and that withdrawal of the culprit drug is recommended when the underlying disease is uncontrolled.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Discontinuation of biologics is not necessary. • Withdrawal of culprit drug is recommended in case of uncontrolled underlying diseases.

mcqs.question: How does the review characterise the immune driver it highlights for paradoxical psoriasis?

options.A: An interferon-mediated inflammatory disease induced by TNF inhibitors or other biologics
options.B: A pure autoantibody disease with no interferon mention
options.C: A bacterial infection of the plaque
options.D: A deficiency of type I interferon

mcqs.explanation: The review's highlights say paradoxical psoriasis is an interferon-mediated inflammatory disease induced by TNF inhibitors or other biologics.

sourceRefs.excerpt: PP is an IFN-mediated inflammatory disease induced by TNF inhibitors or other biologics. •
